title: HealthCore Telemetry Event Schemas
description: JSON Schema catalog for HealthCore telemetry. Identifiers match CONTEXT-healthcore.md and telemetry-plan.md. No PHI in properties.

department.description: Clinical service area; never a patient id

inbound_order_created.title: inbound_order_created
inbound_order_created.x-gold-rule: We capture inbound_order_created because we need to know how much and what supply is purchased by clinic and vendor, which lets us consolidate purchasing and negotiate better vendor terms.

outbound_order_created.title: outbound_order_created
outbound_order_created.x-gold-rule: We capture outbound_order_created because we need to know which supplies are consumed most and at what rate by clinic and department, which lets us adjust automatic replenishment per clinic.

stock_threshold_triggered.title: stock_threshold_triggered
stock_threshold_triggered.x-gold-rule: We capture stock_threshold_triggered because we need to know how often a clinic runs short of critical supply, which lets us prioritise urgent restocking and escalate to Marcus.

direct_stock_edit_rejected.title: direct_stock_edit_rejected
direct_stock_edit_rejected.x-gold-rule: We capture direct_stock_edit_rejected because we need to know if staff attempt to bypass traceability controls, which lets us reinforce training or permissions at the clinic where it happens most.

supply_expiry_flagged.title: supply_expiry_flagged
supply_expiry_flagged.x-gold-rule: We capture supply_expiry_flagged because we need to know which supplies are about to expire, which lets us prioritise use or controlled disposal before waste or compliance risk.

product_created.title: product_created
product_created.x-gold-rule: We capture product_created because we need to know catalogue growth and category mix, which lets us plan stock coverage across clinics.

outbound_order_rejected.title: outbound_order_rejected
outbound_order_rejected.x-gold-rule: We capture outbound_order_rejected because we need to know stock and validation failures by product, which lets us fix UX and operator training.

inbound_order_rejected.title: inbound_order_rejected
inbound_order_rejected.x-gold-rule: We capture inbound_order_rejected because we need to know bad inbound payloads, which lets us improve forms and vendor data quality.

inventory_form_started.title: inventory_form_started
inventory_form_started.x-gold-rule: We capture inventory_form_started because we need to know which inventory flows operators open, which lets us prioritise UX improvements.

inventory_form_abandoned.title: inventory_form_abandoned
inventory_form_abandoned.x-gold-rule: We capture inventory_form_abandoned because we need to know mid-flow drop-off, which lets us simplify inventory forms.

login_succeeded.title: login_succeeded
login_succeeded.x-gold-rule: We capture login_succeeded because we need to know successful access volume, which lets us plan capacity and shift coverage.

login_failed.title: login_failed

email_hash.description: Optional hashed identifier; never raw password

login_failed.x-gold-rule: We capture login_failed because we need to know failed login attempts, which lets us detect brute force and fix auth UX.
login_failed.x-sanitize: Use email_hash only; never raw email.

logout_completed.title: logout_completed
logout_completed.x-gold-rule: We capture logout_completed because we need to know session endings, which lets us measure session hygiene.

user_registered.title: user_registered
user_registered.x-gold-rule: We capture user_registered because we need to know backoffice account growth, which lets us govern access.

password_reset_requested.title: password_reset_requested

result.description: Always accepted to avoid email enumeration

password_reset_requested.x-gold-rule: We capture password_reset_requested because we need to know reset demand, which lets us size support without exposing emails.

password_reset_completed.title: password_reset_completed
password_reset_completed.x-gold-rule: We capture password_reset_completed because we need to know reset completion rate, which lets us reduce token and email friction.

password_reset_failed.title: password_reset_failed
password_reset_failed.x-gold-rule: We capture password_reset_failed because we need to know invalid or expired tokens, which lets us tune TTL and messaging.

password_changed.title: password_changed
password_changed.x-gold-rule: We capture password_changed because we need an audit trail of password changes, which lets us investigate account compromise.

session_unauthorized.title: session_unauthorized
session_unauthorized.x-gold-rule: We capture session_unauthorized because we need to know expired tokens hitting APIs, which lets us improve session renewal UX.

page_viewed.title: page_viewed
page_viewed.x-gold-rule: We capture page_viewed because we need to know which backoffice sections operators visit, which lets us prioritise the product roadmap.

form_abandoned.title: form_abandoned
form_abandoned.x-gold-rule: We capture form_abandoned because we need to know abandoned flows, which lets us reduce friction.

incident_created.title: incident_created
incident_created.x-gold-rule: We capture incident_created because we need incident volume by origin and category, which lets us staff operations appropriately.

incident_validation_failed.title: incident_validation_failed

fields.description: Failing field names only; never free-text values

incident_validation_failed.x-gold-rule: We capture incident_validation_failed because we need to know which fields fail, which lets us improve incident form validation.

incident_status_changed.title: incident_status_changed
incident_status_changed.x-gold-rule: We capture incident_status_changed because we need lifecycle throughput, which lets us manage SLAs and bottlenecks.

incident_status_rejected.title: incident_status_rejected
incident_status_rejected.x-gold-rule: We capture incident_status_rejected because we need illegal transition patterns, which lets us improve UI guards and training.

incident_csv_analyzed.title: incident_csv_analyzed
incident_csv_analyzed.x-gold-rule: We capture incident_csv_analyzed because we need CSV analysis usage, which lets us invest in analyst tooling.

incident_csv_rejected.title: incident_csv_rejected
incident_csv_rejected.x-gold-rule: We capture incident_csv_rejected because we need malformed upload patterns, which lets us improve CSV templates and docs.

incident_results_exported.title: incident_results_exported
incident_results_exported.x-gold-rule: We capture incident_results_exported because we need export demand, which lets us manage results retention.

incident_summary_viewed.title: incident_summary_viewed
incident_summary_viewed.x-gold-rule: We capture incident_summary_viewed because we need summary dashboard usage, which lets us keep the summary actionable.

supplier_created.title: supplier_created
supplier_created.x-gold-rule: We capture supplier_created because we need directory growth, which lets us ensure procurement coverage.

supplier_rate_updated.title: supplier_rate_updated
supplier_rate_updated.x-gold-rule: We capture supplier_rate_updated because we need rate change patterns, which lets us negotiate with inbound purchase data.

supplier_status_changed.title: supplier_status_changed
supplier_status_changed.x-gold-rule: We capture supplier_status_changed because we need activation and suspension patterns, which lets us manage vendor risk.

supplier_deleted.title: supplier_deleted
supplier_deleted.x-gold-rule: We capture supplier_deleted because we need directory removals, which lets us audit procurement hygiene.

talent_list_filtered.title: talent_list_filtered
talent_list_filtered.x-gold-rule: We capture talent_list_filtered because we need recruiter filter patterns, which lets us improve hiring UX.

talent_record_created.title: talent_record_created
talent_record_created.x-gold-rule: We capture talent_record_created because we need pipeline intake volume, which lets Diane track time-to-hire KPIs.

talent_candidate_viewed.title: talent_candidate_viewed
talent_candidate_viewed.x-gold-rule: We capture talent_candidate_viewed because we need attention per candidate, which lets us find pipeline bottlenecks.

website_page_viewed.title: website_page_viewed
website_page_viewed.x-gold-rule: We capture website_page_viewed because we need public traffic patterns, which lets us invest in patient access channels.

intake_form_started.title: intake_form_started
intake_form_started.x-gold-rule: We capture intake_form_started because we need intake funnel starts, which lets us measure conversion.

intake_form_submitted.title: intake_form_submitted

properties.description: Codes only — no name, email, phone, or reason

intake_form_submitted.x-gold-rule: We capture intake_form_submitted because we need submit volume by country and clinic code, which lets us forecast patient access demand without storing PHI.
intake_form_submitted.x-sanitize: No name, email, phone, or reason.

intake_form_validation_failed.title: intake_form_validation_failed

fields.description: Field names only; never field values

intake_form_validation_failed.x-gold-rule: We capture intake_form_validation_failed because we need blocking field patterns, which lets us fix the public form UX.

http_request_failed.title: http_request_failed
http_request_failed.x-gold-rule: We capture http_request_failed because we need error rates by route, which lets us fix reliability before clinics call.

api_unhandled_error.title: api_unhandled_error
api_unhandled_error.x-gold-rule: We capture api_unhandled_error because we need unexpected 500s, which lets us page on-call before widespread failure.

email_send_failed.title: email_send_failed
email_send_failed.x-gold-rule: We capture email_send_failed because we need password-reset email failures, which lets us fix delivery without logging addresses.

job_run_completed.title: job_run_completed
job_run_completed.x-gold-rule: We capture job_run_completed because we need seed and scan job health, which lets operations trust automated inventory maintenance.

session_expired.title: session_expired
session_expired.x-gold-rule: We capture session_expired because we need to know when operators lose session before completing inventory tasks, which lets us improve re-login UX and reduce abandoned orders.

api_latency_recorded.title: api_latency_recorded
api_latency_recorded.x-gold-rule: We capture api_latency_recorded because we need to know which API routes are slow for operators, which lets us fix performance before clinics report the system as broken.

frontend_error_captured.title: frontend_error_captured
frontend_error_captured.x-gold-rule: We capture frontend_error_captured because we need to know uncaught UI errors by route, which lets us fix broken flows before operators lose inventory work.
frontend_error_captured.x-sanitize: Never include error message text that may contain user input or PHI.
